profile.name: Juan Gurdian
profile.headline: AI Engineer @ yorCMO | Co-Founder & CTO, Gynka | Production agents, RAG, MCP | Tampa
profile.availability: Open to Tampa hybrid/onsite and US remote AI engineering roles

about: I build and own production LLM and agent systems for real clients, not demos. Architecture, backend, frontend, integrations, and the product conversations all sit with me. At yorCMO I ship tools fractional CMOs and professional firms use every day. As Co-Founder and CTO of Gynka, I am the sole technical owner of the product: frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure. I use Claude Code and Codex to move faster on implementation and review. I still own design, correctness, evals, and what reaches production.

experience.companyDescription: AI-native fractional CMO firm and Anthropic partner
highlights: Linky (platform lead): autonomous LinkedIn outreach platform on LLM agents. Per client org sources ~6,000 companies and ~12,000 prospects from a defined ICP, researches each, drafts outreach in the user's voice (~90% approved without edits), human approval before send. Directed one engineer.

Built Linky enrichment pipelines (email, phone, LinkedIn, activity, region, fit scoring) and the production agentic loop (daily invites, acceptance detection, three-message cadence, edits feed back as training signal).

CORE Growth Platform: built 4 of 11 production LLM agents serving 24 client orgs across 25+ integrations (LinkedIn/Unipile, WordPress, HubSpot, Google Analytics and Ads, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Apify, Notion, Shopify, Microsoft Graph), plus shared platform structure and backend maintenance.
Built and maintains the MCP server exposing platform agents as tools inside Claude, plus the shared orchestration/tool-calling layer.
PanelCast: meeting-to-content pipeline (brand/voice profiles; on-brand blog posts, per-attendee LinkedIn posts, short-form video).

Practice Growth System: internal lead on a five-agent build from client meeting transcripts (Fathom, Microsoft Graph, approval queue). Pilot delivered on schedule; second org onboarded with no firm-specific code.

Owned guardrails (PII redaction, role-aware prompts), evals (prompt regression, A/B), RBAC/audit logs, backend services across Modal, Vercel, Supabase, AWS with Docker, GitHub Actions, observability, per-agent cost/latency controls.
Sole technical owner of an AI fitness coaching product in closed beta.
Architected the multi-agent AI coach engine on AWS (FastAPI, Pydantic AI, Supabase, ARQ/Redis, RevenueCat).
Built the full iOS and Android app in React Native, distributed via TestFlight.
Coach ingests biomarker data from wearables and adapts each workout toward the user's goal.
Owns schemas, APIs, infra, release process.
Built ML models for chat analytics and user behavior prediction
Implemented NLP features for sentiment analysis
Led digital transformation initiatives for supply chain operations
Built data dashboards and automation tools
